document_title: POLARIS Forecast Uncertainty -> Risk -> EMS Interface Design (V2)
branch: POLARIS — CANDIDATE D V2 MATHEMATICAL REFORMULATION
what_was_wrong_with_v1: Conflated raw ACF (0.6386) with fitted AR coefficient (0.6435), omitting intercept (c=11.73 W/m2) and unconditional mean (mu=32.89 W/m2).
Broken state semantics: accumulated critical demand and shortfall backwards from origin 0 to k, rather than forward from state t across the lookahead window.
Introduced unsupported arbitrary constants: 12.6 kWh floor, erroneous 38.6 kWh EBR claim (actual is 75.65 kWh), uncalibrated epsilon=0.01, and Gaussian z-multipliers.
Subtracted point wind forecast unconditionally with zero uncertainty, directly repeating the primary failure mode of critical-aware EBR (wind over-prediction at low sun).
Assumed Gaussian independent AR innovations despite Ljung-Box test rejecting whiteness (p < 1e-6) and kurtosis showing heavy tails (kappa=3.45).
Conflated solar irradiance (W/m2), electrical PV power (W), inverter clipping (60 kW), and battery energy (Wh).
Claimed a chance constraint without valid coverage guarantees under cross-year distribution drift.
Proposed using station_state.ebr_target_wh_override for vector injection, which only accepts a scalar in GAP19.

ar1_error_model.forward_conditional_mean: hat_e_I(tau | t) = mu(x_tau) * (1 - phi^{tau - t + 1}) + phi^{tau - t + 1} * e_I^{obs}(t)

forward_window_state_semantics.forward_window: W_t = {tau in Z | t <= tau <= min(t + 5, 23)}

cumulative_shortfall_risk.variance_scale: S_C(t, W_t) = sqrt( sum_{tau in W_t} [ sum_{l=tau}^{min(t+5, 23)} phi^{l-tau} ]^2 * sigma_{innov}^2(x_tau) )
cumulative_shortfall_risk.risk_envelope_wh: U_{sol}^{risk}(t, W_t; 1-alpha) = sum_{tau in W_t} 51.0 * Delta t * hat_e_I(tau | t) + Omega_{cal}(1-alpha, x_t) * S_C(t, W_t)

reserve_derivation.gross_critical_energy_wh: E_{crit}^{gross}(t) = (1 / eta_{dis}) * sum_{tau in W_t} P_{crit}[tau] * Delta t
reserve_derivation.credited_renewable_energy_wh: E_{ren}^{credit}(t) = max(0, sum_{tau in W_t} [ hat_P_{pv}[tau] + P_{wind}^{credit}[tau] ] * Delta t - U_{sol}^{risk}(t, W_t; 1-alpha) )
reserve_derivation.survivability_floor_wh: R_{floor}^{surv}(t) = (1 / eta_{dis}) * P_{crit}[t] * Delta t = 11600 / 0.92 = 12608.7 Wh (exactly 1.0 hour critical survivability)

wind_uncertainty_treatment.mode_1_default: Conservative Zero-Credit Baseline: P_{wind}^{credit}(tau) = 0.0 W. Proves wind over-prediction cannot cause critical deficit.
wind_uncertainty_treatment.mode_2_experimental: Empirical Lower-Quantile Wind Crediting: max(0, hat_P_{wind} - Delta_{wind}^{risk}). FLAGGED as unvalidated due to synthetic benchmark wind data.

relationship_to_ebr.mathematical_relation: E_{stage2_target}[t] <= E_{crit}^{gross}(t) = E_{EBR}(t). Reverts exactly to governed 6-hour EBR (75.65 kWh) at night or when solar uncertainty is complete.
relationship_to_ebr.fuel_saving_mechanism: Releases reserve down to 1-hour floor (12.6 kWh) on clear mornings, eliminating step-0 diesel burning.

gap19_research_interface.constraint_layer: Layer C, Constraints 288-311: E_next[t] + s_J2[t] >= E_stage2_target[t] + min_e_wh.
gap19_research_interface.code_modifications: ZERO. GAP19 lines 118-124 natively ingest 24-element vector from config.
gap19_research_interface.invalid_path_warning: station_state.ebr_target_wh_override only accepts scalar float; must remain None.

assumptions_retained: AR(1) captures dominant linear temporal persistence (phi=0.6435).
Irradiance error scale is governed by clear-sky GHI.
1.0 hour critical load survivability floor (12.6 kWh) is required for emergency diesel start buffer.
unsupported_assumptions_removed: Gaussian innovation distribution and white noise.
Backward horizon summation from origin 0 to k.
Arbitrary constants (12.6 kWh floor, 38.6 kWh EBR claim, uncalibrated epsilon).

can_be_validated_offline: Forward-window cumulative shortfall coverage on historical 2020-2022 data.
Conformal calibration of nonconformity multiplier Omega_cal(1-alpha).
Dynamic reserve sensitivity across clear-sky and overcast regimes.
what_remains_blocked: Real wind forecast uncertainty (benchmark wind is synthetic).
Horizons k in [20..24] in historical solar dataset.
Real-time sensor telemetry feedback (quarantined due to unmodeled latency).
